reviewer: sole authorized independent source-blind evaluator; pre-observation author/scope review, not a second human adjudicator
expected_polarity_purpose: 30positive30semantic-negative, both axes independently labelled but same semantic polarity in this cohort.
scope_decisions: All positive launch support is an independent canonical target subject sentence, not a new affirmative launch grammar or numbered reference AST.
Positive14 non_launch_property,9 foreign_event,7 combined_safe_context. Complete physical/document properties or singly identified foreign events are all explicitly outside target launch.

Positive correction scopes include typed Object/Subject/Item, complete apposition/denial-target description, title/heading binding, an adjacent unowned launch-frame owner supplement, author reply/quote and separately checked coordinated/reason/contrast clauses.
Negative11 target_denial,4 global_denial,2 nonexistence,7 unknown_owner,2 mixed_owner,2 conflicting_owner,2 actual missing_context. Each has a semantic reason independent of raw risk.
An explicit foreign supplement may fill only a genuinely unowned frame. It cannot erase a target already named in the frame or resolve expressly unknown/speculative ownership.
A safe property exclusion never covers an independent adverse launch clause or a sourcewide retraction. Separate role/event owners are evaluated individually.
Printed cover words describe the property being corrected; they are not taken as a launch event merely because launch appears in the quoted title.

For Rowan Estuary Clip, full canonical product name appears explicitly in both contexts. The positive is a complete physical property; the negative has a real missing continuation and unestablished withdrawn-claim owner. No raw-risk enum alone determines its semantic gold.
No raw-risk-only negative is included: raw scope_risk is none in all60. Exact supplied/effective tuples will be retained without claims about internal components.
No general reference graph/alias/chronology/new affirmative launch predicate is required. Typed role, apposition and owner adjacency used here are within the declared bounded scope.

pair_reviews.negative_rationale: The second denial explicitly covers the target launch, independently of the seal-color correction.

pair_reviews.positive_rationale: Quoted words are explicitly the value of a printed title property, so denying that property does not deny launch.

freshness: The30 contrasts were authored after M0 and explicit parent authorization without opening/transforming old author/case/input/draft bodies. Uniform public schema, mandatory factual anchor and within-pair matched contexts are experimental structure, not reuse of an old cohort.
truth_boundary: Synthetic authored semantic expectations, not primary-source facts or universal real-world truth. Scope judgments were made before any candidate observation. A bounded API failure will remain a failure under the fixed policy.
known_regression_boundary: Parent1264/14/history are reported pinned controls; no independent replay was performed.
exclusions: No real24, normal CLI, provider/network, Oracle, extra agent or implementation access.
